Elon Musk in new interview on @SpaceXSI's data center site in Memphis:

"I insist on doing some of the work myself manually. I've pulled power cables the size of an anaconda. I've done the fiber optic cabling; I try to do at least a little bit of everything so I'm not numb to the pain of the people who are actually doing it. It's not as though I'm sitting in an office and someone has to come to me. I'm walking the floor asking them questions actively."

(via 33rd Annual Baron Investment Conference today in NYC)
